company.name: Mosaic
company.shortDescription: Mosaic provides curated rental linen and fabric décor collections for weddings, events, and special occasions.
company.description: Mosaic provides curated rental linen and fabric décor collections for weddings, corporate events, and special occasions. The company offers tablecloths, table runners, napkins, chair treatments, aisle runners, drapes, and lounge accents made from fabrics sourced around the world. Mosaic works with event planners, venues, and hosts to select patterns, textures, and colors that suit different event styles. Its catalog includes both basic linens and custom embroidered or artisanal woven options. Mosaic supports clients through galleries and inspiration resources that show how specific fabrics are used in real events. The company also donates surplus fabrics and supports community organizations and industry nonprofits through charitable initiatives and sustainable rental practices.
